newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Renong said eyeing Filipino steel firm.
newsitem.headline: Renong said eyeing Filipino steel firm.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Renong Bhd's executive chairman Halim Saad is looking into the possibility of buying a 69.2 percent stake in Filipino firm National Steel Corp, a local weekly reported on Monday.
The stake in National Steel was sold by another Malaysian company Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd to Hong Kong-based Hottick Investment Ltd in December for 12.17 billion pesos.
Quoting a source close to Hottick, The Edge financial weekly said, "Renong sent feelers out after news that Hottick had closed the deal with Wing Tiek broke out. Discussions are currently ongoing."
Renong officials were not immediately available for comment on Monday.
The Edge said it was not clear which of the Renong companies would be used to buy the stake if talks were successful.
The article did not cite a price for the stake purchase, but said the acquisition would allow infrastructure concern Renong to expand its industrial base.
Renong earlier this month lost a bid to buy the historic Manila Hotel in the Philippines.
